gaps.sentence: She gazed at the mural in silent ___ (ADMIRE).
gaps.explanation: 'In silent admiration' — the noun for the feeling.

gaps.sentence: The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: He's a regular ___ (CONTRIBUTE) to the magazine.
You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.

gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.
